definitions.explanation: Severely negative criticism or evaluation. Used when something is reviewed or judged very harshly.

examples.japanese: {批評家|ひひょうか}に{酷評|こくひょう}された。
examples.english: It was harshly criticized by reviewers.

examples.japanese: {新作|しんさく}は{酷評|こくひょう}の{嵐|あらし}だった。
examples.english: The new work faced a storm of harsh criticism.

examples.japanese: {発売|はつばい}{当初|とうしょ}は{酷評|こくひょう}されたが、{後|のち}に{名作|めいさく}と{評価|ひょうか}された。
examples.english: It was harshly criticized at release but was later recognized as a masterpiece.

notes:
COLLOCATIONS:
- {酷評|こくひょう}される: to be harshly criticized
- {酷評|こくひょう}の{嵐|あらし}: a storm of harsh criticism

OPPOSITE:
- {好評|こうひょう}: favorable reception
- {絶賛|ぜっさん}: high praise
